business_overview.one_sentence: The Group manufactures and sells outdoor wooden products and renewable energy products, with wooden products contributing almost all 2025 revenue.

business_overview.revenue_model: Goods revenue recognised at a point in time upon delivery; payment is generally due within 90-180 days from delivery and advance payment is normally required from customers.
business_notes: 2025 revenue by geography: PRC 66,632, Australasia 369,611, North America 13,256, Europe 26,621, Asia Pacific excluding PRC 3,429, all RMB'000.
